stem: What should happen when a canopy instruction conflicts with an active plant hold?
choices: Continue the canopy task because the work order was issued after the hold was created.
Respect the active hold and resolve the instruction conflict through the controlled escalation process before continuing work on the held material.
Remove the hold label temporarily so the canopy task can be completed and replace it afterward.
Finish the task first and document the hold conflict at shift end.
rationale: An active hold controls material status until it is formally resolved. A conflicting work order does not automatically cancel that status. Technician I should stop work on the held material and escalate the conflict so the correct instruction is confirmed before proceeding.
